answer: Proof of unique smart-home device graph turns identity into something scarce. Because a home full of devices that talk to each other, the cedar of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a home full of devices that talk to each other is something they already have; the ridge falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm doing the maths finds the delta first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
